data.narrative:
Heart Aerospace, a Series B space and aerospace company founded by Anders and Klara Forslund, has raised $185M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers at similar or adjacent stages, including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Skyryse.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis uses the $185M raised as a proxy for current valuation, then applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $352M. Peer-median anchoring across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Sierra Space at $8.0B, Cowboy at $2.0B, Aalyria at $1.3B, Skyryse at $1.1B) produces a median of $1.6B, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comparable P/S anchoring cannot be applied; the sector median stands at 27.4x across six public tickers, but Heart Aerospace's revenue remains undisclosed.

The triangulated range spans $299M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $1.0B across the two applicable methods. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in peer selection and stage-specific comparability. Stage-progression yields the most conservative estimate, while peer median reflects actual transaction data but carries execution and revenue-visibility risk typical of frontier aerospace ventures.
